On Thu, Mar 5, 2026 at 02:20, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com> wrote:
> James — thanks for flagging and for the logs. I'm escalating immediately.

We’re seeing a pronounced increase in 429s and backend 5xx timeouts in the us-west-2 region coincident with upstream DNS timeouts from a third-party resolver. Correlation notes:
- Client retry logs show aggressive retries with constant backoff (no jitter) leading to retry amplification.
- Our transient connection errors to model serving layer increased at the same time as RTTs to cloud metadata/DNS endpoints spiked.
- Traffic patterns align with RetailSync peak window.

Immediate mitigation plan (executing now):
1) Push config to reduce client retry attempts from 5 -> 2 and increase exponential backoff (add jitter) at edge gateways.
2) Enable soft-fallback routing: prefer cached responses and a smaller quantized model for non-critical tokens to reduce load.
3) Apply conservative circuit-breaker on downstream calls for 5xx to prevent retry storms.

I’m attaching a small patch with the rate-limiter and backoff changes (mitigation_patch.diff). I'll monitor error-rate delta. If we still see >8% error rate after changes, we'll trigger failover to a different DNS provider and shift critical traffic to a different region.

Rishi Malhotra
Principal Engineer, Serving Runtime

Subject: Re: RE: Checkout failures — 5xx/429 spikes since midnight (urgent)

Update — changes deployed at 03:15 PT:
- Reduced edge client retries, added jitter.
- Enabled circuit-breaker thresholds for downstream model infra (tripped 2x, recovered).
- Turned on small-model fallback for non-authenticated, non-payment requests and increased cache TTL on prefix cache.

Early signal: 5xx rate dropped from ~18% -> ~7% over 20 minutes; 429s decreased significantly. Latency p99 reduced from ~3.2s -> ~1.1s for degraded paths. Monitoring page: https://pagerduty.com/incidents/PD-98421 and shared drive notes at https://drive.redwood.com/Shared/retailsync-incident-20260305

If error-rate creeps back up we'll initiate cross-region failover and coordinate with the cloud provider to rotate DNS.

- Deployed immediate mitigations (reduced retries + jitter, circuit-breaker, smaller-model fallback, cache TTL increase).
- Error rate reduced to ~6–8% and latency p99 improved on degraded paths.

What we're doing next:
